optimized_sql:
WITH web_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        dd.d_date,
        SUM(SUM(ws.ws_sales_price)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ws.ws_item_sk
            ORDER BY dd.d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim dd
        ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        AND dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, dd.d_date
),
store_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        dd.d_date,
        SUM(SUM(ss.ss_sales_price)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ss.ss_item_sk
            ORDER BY dd.d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim dd
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        AND dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dd.d_date
)
SELECT
    y.item_sk,
    y.d_date,
    y.web_sales,
    y.store_sales,
    y.web_cumulative,
    y.store_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT
        x.item_sk,
        x.d_date,
        x.web_sales,
        x.store_sales,
        MAX(x.web_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY x.item_sk
            ORDER BY x.d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS web_cumulative,
        MAX(x.store_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY x.item_sk
            ORDER BY x.d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CASE WHEN web.item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN web.item_sk ELSE store.item_sk END AS item_sk,
            CASE WHEN web.d_date IS NOT NULL THEN web.d_date ELSE store.d_date END AS d_date,
            web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
            store.cume_sales AS store_sales
        FROM web_v1 web
        FULL OUTER JOIN store_v1 store
            ON web.item_sk = store.item_sk
            AND web.d_date = store.d_date
    ) AS x
) AS y
WHERE y.web_cumulative > y.store_cumulative
ORDER BY y.item_sk, y.d_date
LIMIT 100
